source_class: Jagex post reproduced by third-party archive
assumptions: Only deathless completions. Deaths reduce contribution; any team-level effect is not assumed.
Team completion rate is unknown. 1000-raid rows are hypothetical mechanical expectations, not actual daily supply.
Even per-player EV assumes equal contribution and equal splits; actual allocation uses contribution.
Prices are recent RuneLite OSRS Wiki LOW transactions, not guaranteed order fills.
Unique EV excludes non-unique loot, supplies, raid time, death costs and pet/untradeable items.
Jagex announced planned loot-number balancing; update config when actual changes go live.
